---
title: "Project Contract"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

The existing project uses `data/raw`, `data/interim`, and `data/processed`.
This Manual preserves those names:

- `data/raw` is the immutable staged-input boundary;
- `data/interim` contains disposable derived state;
- `data/processed` contains candidate and versioned release artifacts;
- `notebooks` owns the Manual and pipeline declarations;
- `scripts` contains generated command-line entry points;
- `containers` contains generated recipes and local runtime configuration;
- `artifacts/containers` contains unversioned SIF images;
- `_targets` contains unversioned targets state.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm The Repository Root"}

Run project commands from the repository root. The existing `data/`,
`notebooks/`, and `src/` directories should be present.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-generic file="{{ emit.project_root }}/.gitignore" title="Emit The Local-State Boundary"}

```gitignore
.Rhistory
.RData
.Rproj.user/
.quarto/
notebooks/.quarto/
.envrc
.spack-env/
.uvr/library/
.uvr/cache/
.container-home/
.container-tmp/
containers/runtime/local.env
artifacts/containers/*.sif
_targets/
*.out
*.err
**/*logs/*
**/*labbook
sandbox/**
!sandbox/.gitkeep
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Create Missing Scaffold Directories"}

```sh
mkdir -p artifacts/containers containers/bootstrap containers/build \
  containers/runtime containers/templates scripts tests/testthat
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify The Project Contract"}

```sh
test -d data/raw
test -d data/interim
test -d data/processed
test -d notebooks
test -d src
test -f .gitignore
```

:::
